items.source: Uses of WebServerException in org.springframework.boot.web.server
A ConnectorStartFailedException is thrown when a Tomcat Connector fails to start, for example due to a port clash or incorrect SSL configuration.
items.translation: 当 Tomcat Connector 启动失败时（例如由于端口冲突或不正确的 SSL 配置），会抛出 ConnectorStartFailedException。

items.source: A PortInUseException is thrown when a web server fails to start due to a port already being in use.
items.translation: 当 Web 服务器因端口已被占用而无法启动时，会抛出 `PortInUseException`。
